params.name: type
params.description: Filter the list of commissions by type. Supports advanced filtering: single value, multiple values (comma-separated), or exclusion (prefix with `-`). Examples: `sale`, `sale,lead`, `-click`.

params.name: customerId
params.description: Filter the list of commissions by the associated customer.

params.name: payoutId
params.description: Filter the list of commissions by the associated payout.

params.name: partnerId
params.description: Filter the list of commissions by the associated partner. When specified, takes precedence over `tenantId`. Supports advanced filtering: single value, multiple values (comma-separated), or exclusion (prefix with `-`). Examples: `partner_abc`, `partner_abc,partner_xyz`, `-partner_abc`.

params.name: tenantId
params.description: Filter the list of commissions by the associated partner's `tenantId` (their unique ID within your database).

params.name: groupId
params.description: Filter the list of commissions by the associated partner group. Supports advanced filtering: single value, multiple values (comma-separated), or exclusion (prefix with `-`). Examples: `group_abc`, `group_abc,group_xyz`, `-group_abc`.

params.name: partnerTagId
params.description: Filter the list of commissions by the associated partner tag. Supports advanced filtering: single value, multiple values (comma-separated), or exclusion (prefix with `-`). Examples: `ptag_abc`, `ptag_abc,ptag_xyz`, `-ptag_abc`.

params.name: invoiceId
params.description: Filter the list of commissions by the associated invoice. Since invoiceId is unique on a per-program basis, this will only return one commission per invoice.

params.name: status
params.description: Filter the list of commissions by their corresponding status.

params.name: sortBy
params.description: The field to sort the list of commissions by.

params.name: sortOrder
params.description: The sort order for the list of commissions.

params.name: interval
params.description: The interval to retrieve commissions for.

params.name: start
params.description: The start date of the date range to filter the commissions by.

params.name: end
params.description: The end date of the date range to filter the commissions by.

params.name: endingBefore
params.description: If specified, the query only searches for results before this cursor. Mutually exclusive with `startingAfter`.

params.name: startingAfter
params.description: If specified, the query only searches for results after this cursor. Mutually exclusive with `endingBefore`.

params.name: pageSize
params.description: The number of items per page.

items.docs: Retrieve a paginated list of commissions for your partner program.

Create one or more commissions (custom, lead or sale) for a partner. Commission creation is processed asynchronously. Use the List Commissions endpoint or webhooks to be notified when the commission is created.

params.name: id
params.description: The commission's unique ID on Dub.

items.docs: Update an existing commission amount. This is useful for handling refunds (partial or full) or fraudulent sales.
Bulk update up to 100 commissions with the same status.
